name: Occidental-Fastness
description: There is no surface, only an endless fall through banded clouds: amber belts, cream zones, and storms wide enough to swallow worlds. Lightning flickers between the layers like thoughts of a vast mind.
The air carries wet iron and lichen, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Instruments disagree about the temporal distortion zone: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
Whoever controls antimatter traces controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
